title: Underived affine Koszul Hom coefficient square
statement: Let i:Z -> Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], U an affine open, A=Gamma(Y,U), I=ker(i)(U) [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], n,m natural numbers, and f:Fin n -> A ANY sequence. Let T be tilde followed by chart transport [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections], E the termwise T-image of K_A(f) extended to nonpositive integer cochain degrees [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex], R restriction to U, and B=i_*O_Z. Let a:O_Y -> B be the actual adjunction-unit coefficient map, as specified by ha. Then there are isomorphisms from H^m(Hom_U(E,(R O_Y)[0])) and H^m(Hom_U(E,(R B)[0])) [def-pur-hom-complex] to T of the natural-number dual Koszul homology with A and A/I coefficients, respectively [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex, new-j3-koszul-quotient-coefficient-complex], intertwining the map induced by R(a) with T of the recorded homology coefficient reduction. No Koszul regularity, generation of I by f, resolution, or derived category is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 48.15.5, proof, displayed morphism Hom(K,O_Y) -> Hom(K,O_X); Tag 01HV for exact tilde

proof.text: Identify the restricted pushforward B with T(A/I) through the affine quotient presentation. Construct the identification on basic opens by the localized quotient map; this identifies the specified adjunction unit with A_g -> (A/I)_g, including its module action.

Hom into a coefficient single complex is the signed sheaf dual. Its degree k factor is Hom(E^(-k),coefficient). The exterior-power basis identifies these internal Homs with tilde of module Hom with the same coefficient. Localization of values commutes with the quotient map, so these identifications are natural for a.

The target differential is zero, and the source contribution is -(-1)^k times precomposition, exactly (-1)^(k+1) times the Koszul boundary. Thus the identifications give a commuting square of integer cochain complexes with the extension of the two recorded dual complexes and their reduction map.

Exactness of tilde and chart transport gives natural homology isomorphisms for this square. Compose with the extension homology isomorphisms at m and use their naturality to get the asserted square. The empty sequence, zero ring, empty chart and m>n require no exception.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_koszul_coefficient_hom_coordinates
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (U : Y.affineOpens) (n m : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1))
    (a : SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))
    (ha : a = (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app _ ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map (Scheme.Modules.pullbackObjUnitIso i).hom) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.1.ι
    let S := CochainComplex.singleFunctor U.1.toScheme.Modules 0
    let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom
    let E := (T.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A n f).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
    let H := (homComplexFunctor (R := U.1.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)).obj (op E)
    let D := HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor U.1.toScheme.Modules
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m : ℤ)
    let P := (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulDualComplex A n f).homology m
    let Q := (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulQuotientDualComplex A (i.ker.ideal U) n f).homology m
    let q := HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
      (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulCoefficientReduction A (i.ker.ideal U) n f) m
    ∃ (eF : D.obj (H.obj (S.obj (R.obj (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)))) ≅ T.obj P)
      (eG : D.obj (H.obj (S.obj (R.obj B))) ≅ T.obj Q),
      D.map (H.map (S.map (R.map a))) ≫ eG.hom = eF.hom ≫ T.map q
